product_family: Cloud-based meeting scheduling platform for individuals, teams, and enterprises, with integrated Notetaker, Contacts, and Payments features

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: If you would like access to our full SOC 2 report, along with Calendly's other security and compliance documents, sign our NDA and access our Security Center

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: If you would like access to our full ISO/IEC 27001 report, along with Calendly's other security and compliance documents, sign our NDA and access our Security Center

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 1 and SOC 2/SSAE 16/ISAE 3402 (Previously SAS 70 Type II)

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Calendly relies on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, Standard Contractual Clauses and the UK Addendum to legally transfer Personal Data submitted relating to individuals in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Calendly offers a Business Associate Agreement to eligible Enterprise customers; for other plans, a BAA is typically unavailable. You should not use those plans for PHI (Protected Health Information).

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Calendly uses a PCI-compliant pay processor Stripe for encrypting and storing credit card details. Most PCI compliance requirements are the responsibility of Stripe, our payment processor.

privacy.ai_training_note: No explicit information found regarding AI training on customer data. Notetaker feature uses AI for meeting summaries but no training disclosure visible on public pages.
privacy.data_region: United States (with Google Cloud Platform infrastructure)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: TLS SHA-256 encryption for all browser-to-platform connections

security.name: Password Security
security.value: Passwords stored as salted password hashes

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Kubernetes / Google Cloud Services (GCS) with distributed data centers, continuous monitoring, and layered security

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Documented incident response plan with identification, containment, recovery, and retrospective phases

security.name: Change Management
security.value: New releases thoroughly reviewed and tested; manual peer review by engineering team required before release

security.name: Vulnerability Management
security.value: Continuous monitoring of systems and open source libraries for security issues

security.name: Employee Screening
security.value: Pre-employment background checks and ongoing screening for all employees

products.name: Calendly Scheduling
products.data_scope: Calendar integrations, event details, attendee information, booking data
products.notes: Core product with OAuth integration for Google Calendar, Outlook, Office 365, iCloud (deprecated as of Aug 2024)

products.name: Calendly Notetaker
products.notes: Beta feature with limited availability. Uses AI to generate meeting recaps.

products.name: Calendly Contacts
products.notes: Available on Teams and Enterprise plans for managing relationships and communication tools

products.name: Calendly Payments
products.notes: Integrates Stripe and PayPal for payment processing and invoicing

flags: HIPAA compliance limited to Enterprise tier only; non-Enterprise plans should not handle PHI
Data residency in US only; no EU or other regional data centers
GDPR compliance relies on Data Privacy Framework which is subject to legal challenges; has SCCs and UK Addendum as fallback
ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II reports require NDA to access; vendor-domain links direct to Whistic portal
AI training posture not explicitly disclosed for Notetaker feature; recommend asking vendor directly about opt-out policies
